text:
sam: quick follow-up from the postmortem 
 storage-cleanup created a burst of pages this morning (~90 pages in 8m). need a short list of owners + dates to reduce noise.

anya: yep saw it. ~70% duplicates. root causes: too-low threshold, no dedupe upstream, and a retry storm in the job.

mike: propose owners: 
1) bump storage-cleanup alert threshold 4 -> 15 failures / 10m. owner: mike. due: 2025-04-02.
2) add ingestion dedupe: collapse identical fingerprints within 2m and include count. owner: anya. due: 2025-04-01.
3) auto-silence scheduled-cron jobs +/-2m. owner: leo. due: 2025-03-31.

leo: i'll add the silence rule and PR ops-config. confirm cron for job?

sam: cron is `0 03 * * *` UTC.

anya: i'll implement dedupe with count and a small dashboard to track duplicate ratio.

ops-bot: Created SINF-999 - "storage-cleanup alert noise" -> https://boards.redwood.internal/SINF-999

mike: i'll open the threshold PR and include a quick test showing page reduction.

sam: scheduling a 15m sync Thu 10:00am PST to review PRs. If anyone needs to swap owners or change dates, reply here. Thanks.
